publications.context: Box-supervised pipeline deriving a lesion mask from each bounding box, making radiomic characterisation of 19,810 lesions feasible without new manual delineation. Second author.
publications._notes: Submitted 7 August 2026 to EAAI, under review, NOT accepted. Ema Rachmawati first and corresponding, Rifqi second. 19,810 expert-annotated lesions from BS-80K (12,142 anterior, 7,668 posterior). Fully crossed ablation over 2 segmentation methods, 3 feature representations, 4 classifiers and 2 views, giving 96 configurations. Key result: an 18-dimensional one-hot bone-region indicator raised mean test accuracy from 0.6157 to 0.8491, recall from 0.5077 to 0.8150 and F1 from 0.5539 to 0.8332, improving all 48 paired comparisons at p<0.001 after Holm correction. Without the anatomical prior only 5 of 48 configurations beat the majority-class baseline; with it, 48 of 48.

What remains planned for Telplastina v2 is folding that model into the application. Do not confuse it with the Telrax chest X-ray project, where VQA and visual grounding were three and four other people's modules.
